entry_points.text: Range teardown entry processes a virtual span within one directory entry, with cache maintenance and possible empty table reclaim.
Nonpresent clear entry classifies device, swap, migration, userfault, guard and poison encodings, updates occupancy and references, and preserves markers unless dropping is allowed.
Anonymous huge division entry converts one huge mapping to small mappings under directory lock protection.
Huge zero division entry converts a shared zero huge mapping into individual zero backed small mappings.
Fault folio lock entry returns retry after releasing the fault lock and waiting when required, honoring killable and nowait modes, else blocks for ownership.
Buffered read entry prepares a byte range by cycling batch gather, sync readahead, creation, async trigger and currency checks.

exports.text: Clear or invalidate a huge directory entry, flush its range on all processors, and return the prior entry.
Record anonymous reverse mapping for a run of small pages, and drain deferred reverse mapping removals for a region.
Mark a folio locked with once-only accounting via a per-CPU batch, return the anonymous chain for anonymous folios, and resolve an entry plus address to its normal page.
Restore write-fault markers over a cleared span when prior protection and current configuration require preservation.
Queue folio page ranges for deferred invalidation and freeing, with default and sized forms recording whether reverse mapping work is delayed.

Report next or previous cache miss in a bounded window, look up cache entries with retry semantics, delegate laundering to the holder when needed, and report the leaf entry address plus its protecting lock without acquiring it.
Look up a cached folio by mapping and index with selectable locking, access marking, stability wait, creation, nonblocking and caching-hint behaviours; success returns a referenced folio.
Scan present, contiguous, or dirty plus writeback cache entries over an index interval into a caller batch, advancing the cursor past collected spans.
Perform async readahead on marked folios, sync readahead on misses, and ordered allocation over a window with end-of-file and large-folio handling.

hazards.text: Huge and small translations for the same address must not coexist: invalidate and flush before repopulating, withdraw the backing table only after invalidation, and order publication after small entries are visible.
Multiply mapped pages must never be marked exclusive, anonymous huge PUD mapping is unsupported with a one-time warning, and a negative mapping count after teardown signals accounting corruption.

Reclaiming a leaf table while entries were skipped or repopulated risks freeing a live table; batch exhaustion, dirty entries with delayed accounting, allocation or chain-cap failure force an early flush and break or retry.
Nested batching at finish escalates to whole-address-space scope to avoid stale translations; unknown nonpresent encodings alert and warn once while still clearing the slot.

Retryable, truncated, interrupt and transfer outcomes are control signals: contention uses retryable, races restart lookup or preparation, fatal signals abort, failed reads surface as transfer errors and shrink future readahead.

Caching hints have side effects: creation may pre-mark dropbehind, lookup clears stale dropbehind and adjusts writeback dirty counts for dirty folios on writeback mappings, and missing lock flags on creation are repaired with a one-time warning.

invariants.text: Splits preserve access permissions, status and fault-tracking onto every small entry; zero splits yield zero-backed entries; result kind follows freeze plus migration or device-private state; placement hints are not carried across areas; anon splits need a live referenced folio with counts widened absent freeze.
Huge clear needs aligned address and huge state when present; invalidate needs a present entry and preserves other state while making it inaccessible.

Anon reverse mapping marks exclusivity per page for small and once for huge mappings, forbids multiply mapped exclusive pages, validates chain root and address-derived index, and locks only fully covered lockable non-special areas.
Locked accounting updates only on transition to locked while every call takes a reference and attempts batch insertion; residency deltas collect in a zeroed per-counter vector then fold into totals.

Unmapping skips empty runs, removes everything by default, may keep copy-on-write pages without combining that skip with reclaim, reinstalls write-fault markers only for eligible file areas with prior protection, and propagates dirtiness and recency for file teardown.

Queued pages use one slot for single and two slots with count for multi-page ranges, advancing before fewer than two slots remain; chaining beyond the local batch is disallowed while deferred reverse mapping work is pending.

Encoded reclaim drains in bounded chunks with yields and preserves multi-entry pairs, table freeing is build-dependent with deferred or direct paths, and per-space batched invalidation flushes only when pending and flushed counts differ.

Table reclaim needs build enablement, explicit request and at least a full second-level span; present batch length is bounded by caller max, remaining folio pages and first masked mismatch; swap batches count consecutive same-type offsets increasing by one.

Creation aligns to mapping minimum order, clamps to mapping maximum, reduces on misalignment, retries descending orders with hardened flags, repeats lookup on races, and for reads rejects nonblocking modes and translates concurrent existence into truncated retry.

Read batches stop at interval end, capacity, special or sibling entries, non-current or marked folios; partial currency is rejected when full currency is required or unsupported; failed single reads shrink the readahead window to a quarter.

Readahead grows geometrically capped at maximum with power-of-two init, async trims to order-derived alignment; ordered allocation inserts with marker handling and stops on failure; max pages may expand to device optimum.
Hot marking is suppressed for marked, non-current, readahead, dropbehind or unevictable folios; two offsets share a folio when equal after shifting by folio shift.

locks.text: Range teardown holds the leaf lock while scanning, flushes before release, retries on schedule or batch pressure; empty reclaim takes the higher-level lock then the leaf lock with nesting; brief directory lock acquisition syncs with concurrent huge teardown.
The per-CPU lock batch is guarded by a local lock across lookup, accounting and insertion or flush.
Anon reverse mapping relies on page-lock exclusion against concurrent additions and table-lock coverage for newly installed entries.
Cache scans and miss probes hold read-side protection across traversal and reference acquisition, retrying on invalidation or stale references.
Requested folio locking uses try-lock with retryable contention in nonblocking mode and blocking wait otherwise, revalidates mapping after acquisition, and restarts on truncation.

Read, creation and ordered readahead hold shared invalidation protection across currency checks, insertion and submission; nonblocking reads use the try variant; ordered readahead also suppresses filesystem reclaim.
Async folio lock attempts enqueue the waiter and mark waiters present under the waitqueue IRQ lock before trying ownership, dequeuing promptly on success.

state_machines.text: Huge division moves from huge present through invalidation and flush to temporary table fill then ordered publication; freeze first tries to share exclusive state, falls back to plain division, then uses migration-style entries if freezing persists.

Range teardown cycles among scanning, forced flush, forced break for reschedule or batch limits, retry and final reclaim; marker preservation moves from cleared entry through eligibility checks to installation over the span.

Gather lifecycle moves from init with cleared range and raised pending count through queuing and optional table batching to finish that flushes translations, releases tables and pages, frees overflow batches and drops the count.

Writeback completion clears reclaim desire with rotation when appropriate, ends writeback state with wakeup on last completion, accounts throttled writeback and handles uncached invalidation with an extra held reference.

Read update moves through invalidation and folio-lock acquisition, truncation and currency checks, then success unlock or filler submission; buffered preparation cycles batch collection, sync readahead, creation, async trigger and currency enforcement with restart on truncation.

structs.text: Folio reverse mapping combines per-page, entire-mapping and total-mapped counts plus a large-mapping count; teardown control carries copy-on-write skip, reclaim and marker-drop flags; gather context carries address space, full-space indication and batched state; anon ownership is tag bits in the mapping word.
Gather context keeps an embedded local batch plus a singly linked chain of heap batches with active pointer, entry count, capacity and chain length, with the local batch as chain head.

Observed address space exposes a page tree with host and operations; folios expose mapping, index and currency, readahead, dropbehind, idle, dirty, writeback and evictability flags; batches expose count, array and caller cursors.

Observed readahead state carries limit, window start, size, async portion, order and previous position; control carries mapping, file, index, page count and dropbehind request; file state carries mapping, readahead state and mode.
Size and count constants: huge division fan-out, huge range size and alignment mask, small-page step, and residency vector sizing with the anonymous counter selector.

Level, ownership and control tags: none versus exclusive marking, small versus huge accounting levels with PUD unsupported for anon, lockable versus special areas, anon mapping tags, locked accounting tags, batch pointer tag, marker-drop request, and fault-marker plus trapped-protection indicators.

Lookup and read outcomes distinguish retryable contention, allocation failure, missing entry, concurrent insertion, transfer failure, interruption and truncation retry; control uses symbolic bits for locking, nonblocking, creation, access, stability, cacheability and read-mode selection.
